The Chinese characters for Andrew

As a transliteration, Andrew is usually written 安德鲁 (Ān dé lǔ). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

安
Ān
peace, safe
德
dé
virtue, morality
鲁
lǔ
blunt, the state of Lu

Origin and meaning

From Greek, Andrew carries the meaning “manly, brave”.

About the name Andrew

Saint Andrew is the patron saint of Scotland and one of the twelve apostles.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Andrew suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
